_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The trumpet sounds in Zion; the fast is called.
We return to God with all our hearts.
We are dust, and to dust we return.
Create in us clean hearts, O God.
Now is the day; now is the hour of grace.
We come, pilgrims on the way to the cross.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Feel the gray smudge of ash pressed to your brow, the dust of last year's palms come back to dust.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
The trumpet is blowing in Zion, calling us home — come with your fasting, come with your weeping, come with hearts torn open and not your clothes.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
Wash us, O God, and we shall be clean; create in us a clean heart and begin us again.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
Now is the day of salvation. Lay down the treasure that rusts and take the road that leads home.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The ash is on our brow; we are dust, and to dust we return.
Turn us, O God, and we will return.
Rend your hearts, says the Lord, and not your clothing.
Turn us, O God, and we will return.
Now is the day of grace; come, pilgrims, to the cross.
Turn us, O God, and we will return. Amen.
